doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 所有慢性失眠患者应接受认知行为疗法（CBT-I）作为主要干预。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 药物治疗慢性失眠仅应考虑用于无法参与CBT-I、参与后仍有症状或作为CBT-I临时辅助的患者。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 成人睡眠维持障碍失眠可使用苏沃雷生（suvorexant）治疗。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 成人入睡困难和睡眠维持障碍失眠可使用艾司佐匹克隆（eszopiclone）治疗。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 成人入睡障碍失眠可使用扎来普隆（zaleplon）治疗。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 成人入睡困难和睡眠维持障碍失眠可使用唑吡坦（zolpidem）治疗。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 成人入睡障碍失眠可使用三唑仑（triazolam）治疗。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 成人入睡困难和睡眠维持障碍失眠可使用替马西泮（temazepam）治疗。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 成人入睡障碍失眠可使用雷美替胺（ramelteon）治疗。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 成人睡眠维持障碍失眠可使用多塞平（doxepin）治疗。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 成人不应使用曲唑酮（trazodone）治疗入睡或睡眠维持障碍失眠。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 成人不应使用噻加宾（tiagabine）治疗入睡或睡眠维持障碍失眠。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 成人不应使用苯海拉明（diphenhydramine）治疗入睡或睡眠维持障碍失眠。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 成人不应使用褪黑素（melatonin）治疗入睡或睡眠维持障碍失眠。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 成人不应使用L-色氨酸（tryptophan）治疗入睡或睡眠维持障碍失眠。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 成人不应使用缬草（valerian）治疗入睡或睡眠维持障碍失眠。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 成人慢性失眠患者可使用苏沃雷生治疗睡眠维持性失眠（相对于不治疗）。
entries.section: Suvorexant for the Treatment of Chronic Insomnia
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 成人慢性失眠患者可使用右佐匹克隆治疗睡眠起始和睡眠维持障碍（相对于不治疗）。
entries.section: Eszopiclone for the Treatment of Chronic Insomnia
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 扎来普隆可用于治疗成人慢性失眠中的入睡困难（睡眠起始失眠）。
entries.section: Zaleplon for the Treatment of Chronic Insomnia
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 对于成人慢性失眠，指南建议临床医生使用唑吡坦治疗入睡困难和睡眠维持困难（相对于不治疗），但推荐强度为弱。
entries.section: Zolpidem for the Treatment of Chronic Insomnia
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 三唑仑可用于治疗成人入睡性失眠。
entries.section: Triazolam for the Treatment of Chronic Insomnia
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 替马西泮可用于治疗成人入睡和睡眠维持性失眠。
entries.section: Temazepam for the Treatment of Chronic Insomnia
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 成人慢性失眠患者使用替马西泮15mg，获益大于危害。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 建议使用雷美替胺8mg治疗成人慢性入睡困难型失眠。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 建议使用多塞平3mg或6mg治疗成人慢性睡眠维持型失眠。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 多塞平（3 mg或6 mg）对睡眠维持性失眠有一定疗效，可改善总睡眠时间、入睡后觉醒时间和睡眠效率，且不良反应与安慰剂无显著差异，获益大于风险。
entries.section: Doxepin for the Treatment of Chronic Insomnia
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 不建议使用曲唑酮（50 mg）治疗慢性失眠（睡眠起始或睡眠维持困难）。
entries.section: Trazodone for the Treatment of Chronic Insomnia
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 不建议使用噻加宾（4 mg）治疗原发性失眠（睡眠起始或睡眠维持困难）。
entries.section: Tiagabine for the Treatment of Primary Insomnia
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 不建议使用苯海拉明（50 mg）治疗成人原发性失眠（睡眠起始或睡眠维持困难）。
entries.section: Diphenhydramine for the Treatment of Primary Insomnia
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 不建议成人使用褪黑素治疗入睡困难或睡眠维持障碍（与无治疗相比）。
entries.section: Melatonin for the Treatment of Primary Insomnia
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 不建议成人使用色氨酸治疗入睡困难或睡眠维持障碍（与无治疗相比）。
entries.section: L-tryptophan for the Treatment of Primary Insomnia
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 不建议使用缬草治疗成人失眠（入睡或睡眠维持困难）。
entries.section: Valerian for the Treatment of Primary Insomnia
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 慢性失眠的长期药物治疗应仅限于无法获得或对认知行为治疗无效、经适当筛查无禁忌、能维持长期获益并定期随访的患者。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline

entries.claim: 对于老年失眠患者，应避免使用苯二氮卓类药物，新型苯二氮卓受体激动剂应限制在短期使用（<90天）。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline
